english.title: Make off while required to wait for arrival of constable with CSO / CSV re vagrancy offences
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having been required to wait for the arrival of a constable, with a community support

(A)_[officer]_
(B)_[volunteer]_

who had required you to stop **(..SPECIFY ACTIVITY..), an activity which had given rise to the belief of that

(C)_[officer,]_
(D)_[volunteer,]_

that you were committing an offence under section 3 or 4 of the Vagrancy Act 1824, made off while subject to the requirement to wait
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph7(3) and (7)(a) of Schedule 3C to the Police Reform Act 2002.

other.powersofarrest:
Arrest without warrant(constable)
CSOs/CSVs designated under section 38 of the Police Reform Act 2002 have no power to arrest, see section 38(6B) and paragraph 1 of Schedule 3B (excluded powers); however, there is a power to detain the person for a maximum of 30 minutes pending the arrival of a constable, see paragraph 7 of Schedule 3C to the Police Reform Act 2002.
